items.title: Challenging Exile: Japanese Canadians and the Wartime Constitution
items.author: Discover Library and Archives Canada
items.content: In September 1945, thousands of Japanese Canadians who had already endured internment and dispossession faced a new threat: forced exile to war-torn Japan. Join us for a thought-provoking conversation with Eric M. Adams and Jordan Stanger-Ross, authors of Challenging Exile: Japanese Canadians and the Wartime Constitution, moderated by Professor Emerita Audrey Kobayashi.

items.title: Howie Morenz: Hockey's First Legend
items.author: Discover Library and Archives Canada
items.content: In this episode, we feature a discussion between Andrew Ross, Director, Research Support at Library and Archives Canada and Donald Murray, author of Howie Morenz: The Greatest Season in the Life of Hockey’s First Legend. Join us as we unravel what made Howie Morenz one of hockey’s most compelling figures, on and off the ice.
